title: psoralidium collinum
intro: Psoralidium collinum, commonly known as scurfpea, is a perennial plant belonging to the legume family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Psoralidium collinum include reducing inflammation, treating skin conditions, and providing relief from gastrointestinal issues, all of which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids. Additionally, the bioactive constituents of Psoralidium collinum have been found to exhibit cytotoxic and free radical scavenging activities.
